# D3 7.9.0

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/d3/7.9.0

Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/d3/-/d3-7.9.0.tgz

License: ISC (LICENSE.txt). Registry SHA-512 integrity verified during vendoring.

SHA-256 (d3.min.js): `f2094bbf6141b359722c4fe454eb6c4b0f0e42cc10cc7af921fc158fceb86539`

The bundle uses LF line endings, pinned by the repository's `.gitattributes` so Windows checkout conversion cannot change the verified bytes.

The bundle runs only inside the opaque-origin visualization iframe, never in Zotero chrome or a privileged Gecko sandbox. The fixed CDN script reference is replaced by this bundle. Preview does not download resources.
